reviews.author: Joanne Lao
reviews.text:
My favorite place in Hongdae is this little store. It's a bit far from the station, so I don't think lazy tourists would bother to visit.

Beautiful mid- to low-priced jewelry designed by the owner himself is on display. Unlike many other stores in Seoul, this place has a really cozy and comfortable atmosphere. It feels like I'm at a friend's studio on a quiet afternoon. The owner, who received design training in Italy, perfectly created a romantic atmosphere without being excessive. Above all, the owner, who is very much an artist, gave me jewelry of his own design and a bookmark with a hand-drawn flower picture as a gift.

It's such a shame that I only discovered this store the day before the last day of my trip.

reviews.author: Tran Phuong
reviews.text: I bought quite a few things. However, not only did the staff not speak English (of course that's okay), but they were also very unfriendly and not welcoming at all. There were a lot of employees, but no one wanted to help, and even though I was carrying four large shopping bags, I had to carry the basket by myself. (At the Innisfree store I went to before, the employees personally carried the basket and showed me the products.) It's okay to hold the basket, but the employees' attitude was very unpleasant. When I left, they didn't even open the door or say thank you or goodbye. There was only one employee who treated me kindly, and that employee didn't look Korean (his skin color was a little darker than the other employees).

reviews.author: jay Kim
reviews.text: I was wandering around Hongik University looking to have a delicious dinner. The store looked open and had many customers. Among them, there were quite a few foreigners, so I went in wondering what was going on. The unique interior concept and the cute appearance of an antique museum. On the basement floor, there was a cash register and earrings, rings, etc. placed like an operating table, just like a scene from a movie. I felt like women wouldn't be able to stop by here and not buy something. Especially if I went with my boyfriend, it felt like I had to buy something. I ended up buying earrings and got a ring.  It was good value for money and they provided service that only included receipts. I don't know how long it would last, but from the outside, it looked like it was a church building, and it seemed like they had bought the whole thing and were using the whole thing.
